summary.text: Collette Brown is a Democratic member of the North Dakota House of Representatives from District 9 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an executive director with a bachelor's degree in finance management.

paragraphs.text: Collette Brown earned a bachelor's degree in finance management from Mayville State University and works as an executive director.
Her legislative biography lists a life partner, Jason Thompson, and three children.
Ballotpedia lists Brown as a candidate for North Dakota State Senate District 15 in 2022, a general election she lost, and as winning a House District 9 seat in 2024.
She assumed office on December 1, 2024, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026; fellow Democrat Duane Poitra is also on the general election ballot.
Her 2025 assignments include the Government and Veterans Affairs and Industry, Business and Labor committees, and she serves on the interim Education and Tribal and State Relations committees.
